data.description:
## Context
The default test suite passes but `tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py::test_install_from_sdist_preserves_commit` emits Python's `DeprecationWarning` at line 143: Python 3.14 will filter extracted tar archives by default and may reject files or modify metadata. The test calls `TarFile.extractall(extracted)` without an explicit `filter=` policy.

## Reproduction
Run the named test with warnings enabled under the repository virtualenv. The warning is deterministic on Python 3.12 and identifies the future 3.14 behavior change.

## Plan
Use rebar-debug to establish the intended safe extraction policy and prove whether the test fixture requires metadata that a standard filter changes. Apply the smallest compatibility repair with a RED warning-as-error oracle; do not weaken archive-safety behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The named build-provenance test runs with its tar extraction warning promoted to an error and passes.
- [ ] The selected extraction filter is explicit and justified against the fixture's required metadata.
- [ ] Existing build-provenance assertions remain unchanged or stronger.
- [ ] The focused test and repository gates pass.
data.title: Python 3.14 tar extraction warning in build-provenance test
